tasks.task: Confirm the appliance model and serial number against the service log.
Ask the user about any faults; read the fault history (d.60 to d.69).
Check clearances and ventilation still meet the installation manual.
Visually inspect the flue route, terminal position and all flue joints.
Carry out a gas tightness test.
Record inlet standing pressure (20 mbar ± 1) and working pressure at maximum rate (17 mbar minimum).
Gas rate the appliance at maximum: 2.6 m³/h ± 5%.
Run a combustion analysis at maximum rate: CO2 9.2% ± 0.3, CO/CO2 ratio below 0.004.
Run a combustion analysis at minimum rate: CO2 8.8% ± 0.3.
Check O2 at the air intake test point is above 20.5%.
Only open the combustion chamber if readings are out of tolerance, or at the 5-year strip-down service.
If opened: inspect the burner, clean the heat exchanger with a nylon brush and replace the burner door seal (service kit).
Check the electrode gap is 4.0 mm ± 0.5 and replace the electrode gasket if disturbed.
Record flame ionisation current: more than 2.0 µA at minimum rate.
Remove, clean and refill the condensate trap.
Check the discharge route for fall, support and frost protection.
Check the expansion vessel pre-charge is 1.0 bar with the system side at 0 bar.
Check the pressure relief valve and discharge pipe.
Confirm cold fill pressure is 1.0 to 1.5 bar.
Clean the magnetic filter and check inhibitor concentration.
Record hot water flow rate and temperature rise: 9.8 l/min at 35 °C rise.
Check the diverter valve changes over cleanly.
Clean the cold inlet filter and check the flow turbine reading (d.36).
Check earth continuity, polarity and fuse rating (3 A).
Check the operation of the overheat thermostat and all safety devices.
Check the firmware version (d.95) against current technical bulletins.
Check room controls, programmer and frost protection.
Reset the service reminder (d.96 = 0).
Complete the service log and record all readings.
Leave the appliance in normal operation and explain any findings to the user.

Clean the cold inlet filter and check the flow turbine reading (d.36).
